plan.title: Single-stage RFQ ceiling price control with setting off

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen specified by the case.
Configure the required vendor-lock setting before creating the event.
Put the tenant in the read-only ceiling-price configuration under test.
Set the event type to RFQ and use the required single-vendor awarding mode.
Provide the mandatory event title so the create screen is valid for inspection.
Choose the first available RFQ pricing template, corresponding to choosing Buy Template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Confirm the requested quantity was entered before inspecting the ceiling-price control.
Click the matching ceiling-price control if offered and record what opens, changes, is disabled, or does nothing.
Assert the resulting screen has no crash, server error, raw identifiers, or invalid rendering.
